blurb: A city district sandbox of streets and alleys: the author's whole map.
author: Fishke
attribution: Converted from rp_southside, https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2010286798 by Fishke. Drawn from the map's own geometry with free (CC0) textures and stand-in models, listed in its world pack's credits; the author's textures and models are not carried. The author can have this conversion removed: contact https://github.com/zees-games/playlot-maps/issues.
